name: Bulwark
fantasy: The squad's shield. Holds the line, plants a banner, leaps in to save an ally at the edge.
silhouette: the shield shape and the banner

passive.name: Guard
passive.desc: Damage your shield, walls or Interpose guard blocks becomes Guard (1 per 2 blocked, max 100). Spent by Shield Slam (50), the Interpose ally shield (20) and Bastion (all of it, +1s per 50).

dash.name: Interpose
dash.desc: Tap: a braced 2.6m step that blocks shots from the front during it and 0.3s after, unshoveable. With an ally under the cursor (8m): leap to them, shield allies near the landing 15 and push foes off them.

variants.hold: Raise the shield: 160 HP, regenerating; it blocks from the front.
variants.tap: Bash: a 2.5m cone, 10 damage, push 8, stun 0.8 into a wall.
variants.air: Shield Surf: hold to block from the front while gliding.
variants.during_e: Inside your Banner the shield is wider and a Bash heals allies behind you 8.
variants.full: Guard 50+: Shield Slam, push 12 and stun 0.6 even without a wall (spends 50).

e.name: Rally Banner
e.desc: Plant a banner up to 7m away for 6s (60 HP, 4m): allies inside gain 6 shield a second (up to 24), foes inside are slowed.

r.name: Bastion
r.desc: A 0.35s plant, then a 4.5m dome for 4s: rival shots from outside stop at it, foes inside are pushed out, allies inside regenerate 8/s. Spends all your Guard for +1s per 50.

rank3.dash: the ally leap's targeting radius is 9m

tells.full: the crest glows; a 0.3s shield flare before a Slam
